sourceType: AI-generated material approximation; not photogrammetry or measured PBR
licence: Generated for this project by its owner through OpenAI ImageGen; no third-party source texture supplied.
sourceImages: Original generated PNGs alongside this record; albedo, roughness and normal share a matching image composition.
encoding: Albedo 512px, normal/roughness 256px; Lanczos downsampling; complete mip chain; Zstandard supercompression of RGBA8, not GPU block compression. Bottom image row stored first, KTXorientation ru, runtime flipY=false.
normalConvention: OpenGL tangent space. Normal strength .24. Bark source green channel inverted during packing after directional comparison; oak source retained.

orientationCheck.method: Compare smoothed source-scale luminance gradients with normal R/G, plus inspect relief under directional light. Luminance is only a diagnostic approximation to height, not a measured displacement source.
orientationCheck.barkRuntimeGreen: inverted to positive image-down gradient direction; bottom-row-first packing keeps OpenGL UV direction

promptSummary: Neutral, evenly lit, tileable weathered oak timber with vertical fibres, knots and cracks. Matching generated grayscale roughness and tangent-space normal requested as data textures; no measured material capture claimed.
